name: KETOPROFEN 100 MG 15 CAPSULES
description: Ketoprofen is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) with analgesic (pain reliever) and antipyretic (fever reducer) properties. Its mechanism of action is by inhibiting cyclooxygenase, an enzyme that produces prostaglandins, which cause inflammation and pain. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
